Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Engineer (Modeling & Simulation) post is 23rd August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. or equivalent in the relevant field, or an M.Tech./M.S. with at least 2 years of post-qualification experience. A strong academic record is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive, as per the available information.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the post of Project Engineer (Modeling & Simulation) in this recruitment drive by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Engineer (Modeling & Simulation) is a contractual role, offering a fixed-term engagement.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SPON/10455/Adv0289.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with an M.Tech./M.S. or equivalent qualification are eligible, provided they have a minimum of 02 years of relevant post-qualification experience.
